info.name: StoneAcademy - Payment + Stripe Connect Full Flow
info.description: Complete frontend/backend integration collection for StoneAcademy payments: host Stripe Connect onboarding, event-ticket platform charge checkout, cancellation refunds, completion settlement transfers, creator withdrawal/payout, admin billing, subscription payments, and Stripe webhook reference requests. Do not place Stripe secret keys in this collection.
